name: Cummins India Ltd
title: Cummins India Ltd - 500480 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Cummins India FY26 sales up 18% to INR11,950 crore with data centres at 30-35% of domestic power gen, but management guided only moderate growth, flagged commodity and supplier cost pressure, and gave no new capacity; utilisation about 70%.

utilisation.quote: our overall capacity utilization is hovering around 70% today

capex.peers_comment: Parent investing close to $450 million to add 20 GW capacity by 2030, per analyst question; management confirmed capacity additions for engines for data centres.
capex.quote: we are adding capacity as our parent has mentioned, and this largely goes towards engines that go into data center market

triggers.label: Data centre share 30-35% of power gen
triggers.quote: the data center business would have contributed between 30% to 35% of our overall power generation domestic revenue
triggers.highlight: 30% to 35% of our overall power generation

triggers.label: FY27 guided to moderate growth only
triggers.quote: The company expects moderate growth across segments in the financial year 2026/'27.

triggers.label: No major capex; utilisation ~70%
triggers.quote: For now, no major capital expenditure plan.

triggers.label: Power gen pricing largely sustaining
triggers.quote: Largely pricing has sustained at the levels we have.

guidance.quote: The company expects moderate growth across segments in the financial year 2026/'27.

red_flags.label: Commodity and supplier cost pressure on orders already taken
red_flags.quote: We, of course, try to pass on the commodity increases to our customers. There usually is some lag

evasions.quote: I won't be able to give you a currency depreciation number.
that would be very tough to do
that is very difficult to answer
we are not able to share with you what we see as the contribution
